reason: This plugin is primarily a service orchestration and management tool for DSH web sessions: it adds a Service tab and model tools to start/stop/restart/list/log long-running processes, while a detached broker supervises those processes across conversation/session boundaries with restart and readiness logic. The main risk is local process lifecycle control (arbitrary command execution and log/state file handling), which matches an automation/orchestration utility class.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH 插件，用于在独立的 broker 进程中持续运行并管理长期服务，并通过侧边栏服务卡片与模型工具提供启动、停止、重启、列表和日志查看等服务管理操作。
summaries.en: dsh-launch is a DSH plugin for running and managing long-lived services in a detached broker process, with a sidebar and model tools for starting, stopping, restarting, listing, and viewing service logs.

capabilities: Starts and supervises long-running command-line services (dev servers/watchers/mock APIs) via model tools
Keeps services running across conversation/session/broker restarts through a detached broker process
Provides UI and tool actions for starting, stopping, restarting, listing, and reading service logs
Maintains local runtime state/log metadata (PID, status, logs, presence) for service tracking
Exposes internal service-management routes for broker/client interaction

reasons.code: README documents `service_start`/`service_stop`/`service_restart`/`service_list`/`service_logs` model tools and a Service sidebar card for operational control.
README describes detached broker architecture with PID tracking, readiness checks, crash backoff restart, and log handling to survive session end and DSH restarts.
README and package description state the plugin runs services as the current DSH user and without sandboxing, which increases local process-control risk while enabling intended persistence.
package.json declares this as a DSH plugin bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch`, client/web platform), confirming integration into runtime and UI surfaces.
